item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nP={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}\\ndef req(**c): return {'claim':'x','conditions':c}\\ndef ev(source,value,conditions=None,**kw):\\n d={'source':source,'claim':'x','value':value,'conditions':conditions if conditions is not None else {'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}; d.update(kw); return d\\ncases=[\\n ('missing',req(a=1),[],P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']}),\\n ('none',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('z',1,{'a':1,'b':3})],P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}),\\n ('supersede',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('old',1),ev('new',2,supersedes=['old'])],P,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}),\\n ('conflict',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('b',{'q':1}),ev('a',{'q':2})],P,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}),\\n ('canonical',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('b',{'z':2,'a':1}),ev('a',{'a':1,'z':2})],P,{'status':'supported','value':{'z':2,'a':1},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]}),\\n ('false',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('f',False)],P,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]}),\\n ('verified',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('u',8,verified=False)],P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}),\\n ('withdrawn',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('w',8,withdrawn=True)],P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}),\\n]\\nfor name,r,e,p,want in cases:\\n before=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); got=evaluate(r,e,p); assert got==want,(name,got,want); assert (r,e,p)==before,name\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('evidence.json') as f: es=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report==[evaluate(r,es,p) for r in rs]\\nprint('ok',len(cases),'cases; report current')\"]}"}
